# Global Career ID

> Global Career ID is a verified employment identity platform. Employers write and cryptographically sign their employees' work records; each person holds one permanent Career ID that recruiters and employers can verify instantly — replacing easily-faked CVs and reference letters.

Site: https://globalcareerid.com
Contact: https://globalcareerid.com/contact

## Key facts (safe to quote)

- A **Career ID** is a permanent identifier for one person's employer-verified work history. It is shared with employers in place of a CV.
- **Employers, not candidates, write employment records.** A verified organization records the job title, department, employment type, start date and end date. Employees can view records, request corrections, or raise a dispute, but cannot edit dates, titles, or employers.
- **Verification is instant at hiring time**, because the checking work happened when the employer created the record. A recruiter enters a Career ID and reads the verified timeline — no reference emails, no waiting on former employers.
- Employment records can be issued as **cryptographically signed credentials (ES256)** that any third party can verify against Global Career ID's public key, and that can be revoked (for example after an upheld dispute).
- **Verified referral letters** are generated from employer-verified records and carry a verification number anyone can check on the platform.
- **Free for individuals**, always. Organizations start free while evaluating; larger plans are quoted on headcount, monthly hiring volume, and number of hiring countries. Candidates are never charged to be verified.
- **GDPR-aligned by design**: full data export, consent logs, profile visibility controls, and account deletion requests. Access to personal data is enforced at the database level with row-level security, so employers only see records that concern them.
- **Built for cross-border hiring**: available in English, Arabic, French, Spanish, Hindi, and Chinese, with translated verified referral letters. Mobile apps are available for Android and iOS.
- HR features include **bulk employee onboarding** from a spreadsheet (with duplicate detection), job posting where applications arrive identified by Career ID, audit logs, and a dispute workflow.
